item.description:
Deploy apps in one click with @cursor_ai.

• No account to create
• No deployment configuration
• Database provisioning included

Built on Vercel for Platforms → https://vercel.com/for/platforms
Cursor: You can now build live apps in Cursor and share them with a link.

Agents have made it easier to write code, but most apps never make it off localhost. Describe the tool you want - Cursor will build it, set up a database, run deterministic and agentic security checks, and deploy.


Link: https://x.com/cursor_ai/status/2118458629091426304
